# Prepare Data

## Retrieve metadata
```{r}
metadata <- read.delim("data/METADATA/ADOVAC_merged_virome_metadata.csv", sep=",", header=T)
metadata_indiv_samples <- read.delim("data/METADATA/ADOVAC_virome_metadata.csv", sep=",", header=T)
```

## MERGED SAMPLES

**DE NOVO ASSEMBLY APPROACH**

### Retrieve abundance table

```{r}
abundance_table <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/ABUNDANCES/abundance_table_merged.csv", sep=",", header=T, check.names = FALSE)

# Create 3 lists: all names, samples only, negative controls and positive controls
allnames <- metadata %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

samples <- metadata %>% 
    filter(!CONDITION == "Control") %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

acne <- metadata %>% 
    filter(CONDITION == "Acne") %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

healthy <- metadata %>% 
    filter(CONDITION == "Healthy") %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

neg_controls <- metadata %>%
    filter(grepl("NC", SAMPLE_ID)) %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

pos_controls <- metadata %>%
    filter(grepl("PC", SAMPLE_ID)) %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)
```

### Calculate prevalence and total abundances ---- 

```{r}
Prevalence_abundance <- abundance_table %>%
    mutate(
        PrevalenceSamples = rowSums(select(., all_of(samples)) != 0),
        PrevalenceNegControls = rowSums(select(., all_of(neg_controls)) != 0),
        PrevalencePosControls = rowSums(select(., all_of(pos_controls)) != 0),
        AbundanceSamples = rowSums(select(., all_of(samples))),
        AbundanceNegControls = rowSums(select(., all_of(neg_controls))),
        AbundancePosControls = rowSums(select(., all_of(pos_controls)))) %>%
    select(-all_of(allnames))
```

### Generate taxonomy table

#### Load Diamond output
```{r}
Taxonomy_Diamond <- read.csv("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/DIAMOND/ADOVAC_merged.1000_contigs_95-85_diamond_taxonomy.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")
colnames(Taxonomy_Diamond) <- c('CONTIGS', 'Diamond_Classification', 'Diamond_Phylum', 'Diamond_Class', 'Diamond_Order', 'Diamond_Family', 'Diamond_Genus', 'Diamond_Species')
```

#### Load geNomad output

```{r}
Taxonomy_Genomad <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/GENOMAD/All_samples_clustered_95-85_virus_taxonomy_merged.tsv", header = TRUE)
colnames(Taxonomy_Genomad) <- c('CONTIGS', 'Genomad_Classification', 'Genomad_Realm', 'Genomad_Kingdom', 'Genomad_Phylum', 'Genomad_Class', 'Genomad_Order', 'Genomad_Family', 'Genomad_Subfamily', 'Genomad_Genus', 'Genomad_Species')
Taxonomy_Genomad <- subset(Taxonomy_Genomad, select = -c(Genomad_Realm, Genomad_Kingdom, Genomad_Subfamily))
```

#### Merge outputs to build taxonomy table

```{r}
taxonomy_table <- abundance_table %>%
    select(CONTIGS) %>%
    left_join(Taxonomy_Diamond, by = "CONTIGS") %>%
    left_join(Taxonomy_Genomad, by = "CONTIGS")
```

#### Identify eukaryotic viruses and phages based on ICTV's host source

```{r}
ICTV_taxa <- read_excel("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/VMR_MSL41.v1.20260320.xlsx", "VMR MSL41", col_types = "text")
ICTV_ranks <- c("Realm","Subrealm","Kingdom","Subkingdom","Phylum","Subphylum","Class","Subclass","Order","Suborder","Family","Subfamily","Genus","Subgenus","Species")

ICTV_phages_taxa <- ICTV_taxa %>%
    filter(`Host source` %in% c("bacteria", "bacteria, vertebrates (S)", "bacteria, invertebrates (S)"))

ICTV_phages_taxa_list <- ICTV_phages_taxa %>%
    select(all_of(ICTV_ranks)) %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique() %>%
    na.omit()

ICTV_eukvir_taxa <- ICTV_taxa %>%
    filter(!`Host source` %in% c("bacteria", "bacteria, vertebrates (S)", "bacteria, invertebrates (S)", "archaea")) #I also remove the archaea as the Caudoviricetes class contains both archaeal and bacterial viruses

ICTV_eukvir_taxa_list <- ICTV_eukvir_taxa %>%
    select(all_of(ICTV_ranks)) %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique() %>%
    na.omit()

taxa_ambiguous <- intersect(ICTV_phages_taxa_list, ICTV_eukvir_taxa_list)

ICTV_phages_taxa_list <- setdiff(ICTV_phages_taxa_list, taxa_ambiguous)
ICTV_eukvir_taxa_list <- setdiff(ICTV_eukvir_taxa_list, taxa_ambiguous)

annotations_tools <- c("Diamond", "Genomad")

for (tool in annotations_tools){
    classification <- paste0(tool, "_Classification")
    for (rank in ICTV_ranks){
        tool_rank <- paste0(tool, "_", rank)
        if (tool_rank %in% colnames(taxonomy_table)){
            taxonomy_table[,classification] <- ifelse(is.na(taxonomy_table[,classification]) | taxonomy_table[,classification] == "" | taxonomy_table[,classification] == "Root", 
                                                      "Unknown", taxonomy_table[,classification])
            taxonomy_table[,classification] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table[,classification] == "Viruses" & taxonomy_table[,tool_rank] %in% ICTV_phages_taxa_list,
                                                      "Prokaryotic viruses", taxonomy_table[,classification])
            taxonomy_table[,classification] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table[,classification] == "Viruses" & taxonomy_table[,tool_rank] %in% ICTV_eukvir_taxa_list,
                                                      "Eukaryotic viruses", taxonomy_table[,classification])
        }
    }
    taxonomy_table[,classification] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table[,classification] == "Viruses",
                                              "Unclassified viruses", taxonomy_table[,classification])
}

taxonomy_table$Genomad_Classification <- ifelse(taxonomy_table$Genomad_Classification == "Unclassified", "Unclassified viruses", taxonomy_table$Genomad_Classification)

levels <- c("Classification", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")

for (tool in annotations_tools){
    for (i in 1:(length(levels)-1)){
        tool_rank <- paste0(tool, "_", levels[i+1])
        if (tool_rank %in% colnames(taxonomy_table)){
            tool_rank0 <- paste0(tool, "_", levels[i])
            taxonomy_table[,tool_rank] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table[,tool_rank] == "" | is.na(taxonomy_table[,tool_rank]),
                                                 gsub("Unclassified Unclassified", "Unclassified", paste("Unclassified", taxonomy_table[,tool_rank0])),
                                                 taxonomy_table[,tool_rank])
            taxonomy_table[,tool_rank] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table[,tool_rank] == "Unclassified Unknown", "Unknown", taxonomy_table[,tool_rank])
        }
    }        
}

rm(i, classification, rank, tool, tool_rank, tool_rank0)
```

#### Insert final classification of contigs in taxonomy table

```{r}
taxonomy_table$Final_Tool <- "1"

taxonomy_table <- taxonomy_table %>%
    mutate(
        Final_Tool = case_when(
            Genomad_Classification == "Prokaryotic viruses" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Genomad",
            Diamond_Classification == "Eukaryotic viruses" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Genomad_Classification == "Unclassified viruses" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Genomad",
            Diamond_Classification %in% c("Unclassified viruses", "Prokaryotic viruses") &
                Genomad_Classification == "Eukaryotic viruses" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Tool clash",
            Diamond_Classification == "Bacteria" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Diamond_Classification == "Eukaryota" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Diamond_Classification == "Archaea" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Diamond_Classification == "Unknown" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Genomad_Classification == "Unknown" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Genomad",
            TRUE ~ Final_Tool
        )
    )

for (i in 1:(length(levels))) {
    final_level <- paste0("Final", "_", levels[i])
    diamond_level <- paste0("Diamond", "_", levels[i])
    genomad_level <- paste0("Genomad", "_", levels[i])
    taxonomy_table[,final_level] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table$Final_Tool == "Diamond", taxonomy_table[,diamond_level],
                                           ifelse(taxonomy_table$Final_Tool == "Genomad", taxonomy_table[,genomad_level], 
                                                         ifelse(taxonomy_table$Final_Tool == "Tool clash", "Unclassified viruses", NA)))
}
```

### Generate Mastertable

#### Load CheckV ouput

```{r}
CheckV_output <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/PHAGE_ANNOTATION/CHECKV/quality_summary_R_merged.tsv", header = TRUE)
colnames(CheckV_output) <- c('CONTIGS', 'provirus', 'proviral length', 'total_genes', 'viral_genes', 'checkv_quality', 'completeness')
```

#### Load geNomad ouput

```{r}
geNomad_output <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/GENOMAD/All_samples_clustered_95-85_virus_scores_merged.tsv", header = TRUE)
colnames(geNomad_output) <- c('CONTIGS', 'length', 'topology', 'coordinates', 'n_genes', 'genetic_code', 'virus_score', 'fdr', 'n_hallmarks', 'marker_enrichment')
geNomad_output$CONTIGS <- gsub("\\|provirus_.*", "", geNomad_output$CONTIGS)
  
viromics_tools_table <- merge(CheckV_output, geNomad_output, by = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
```

#### Create a Mastertable merging abundance table, taxonomy table, and viromics tools 

```{r}
Mastertable <- merge(abundance_table, taxonomy_table[, grepl("CONTIGS|^Final_", colnames(taxonomy_table))], by = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
Mastertable <- merge(Mastertable, viromics_tools_table, by = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
Mastertable <- merge(Mastertable, Prevalence_abundance, by = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
```

#### Add genome length

```{r}
Mastertable$length[is.na(Mastertable$length)] <- gsub('.*_length_','',Mastertable$CONTIGS[is.na(Mastertable$length)])
Mastertable$length <- as.numeric(gsub("_cov_.*","",Mastertable$length))
```

#### Add phage host prediction

```{r}
iphop_output <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/PHAGE_ANNOTATION/HOST_PREDICTION/Host_prediction_to_genus_m90.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

iphop_output <- iphop_output %>%
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>% 
    separate_rows(List.of.methods, sep = " ") %>%
    separate(List.of.methods, into = c("Method", "Score"), sep = ";") %>%
    mutate(Score = as.numeric(Score)) %>%
    group_by(row_id) %>%
    mutate(pair_id = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = pair_id,
        values_from = c(Method, Score),
        names_glue = "{.value}.{pair_id}") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-row_id) %>%
    mutate(Sum.Score = rowSums(across(starts_with("Score.")), na.rm = TRUE))

iphop_output <- iphop_output %>%
    rename(CONTIGS = Virus) %>%
    mutate(Host.genus = gsub("[dpcofg]__", "", Host.genus)) %>%
    separate(Host.genus, c("Host_Domain","Host_Phylum", "Host_Class", "Host_Order", "Host_Family", "Host_Genus"), sep = ";") %>%
    mutate(Host_Genus = gsub("_[A-Za-z]$", "", Host_Genus)) %>%
    group_by(CONTIGS) %>%
    arrange(desc(Confidence.score), desc(Sum.Score), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(CONTIGS, matches("^Host_"))

Mastertable <- left_join(Mastertable, iphop_output, by = "CONTIGS")
```

### Remove all contigs considered as contaminants and present in NEGATIVE controls

```{r}
Mastertable_decontam <- Mastertable[!Mastertable$PrevalenceNegControls > 0,]
```

### Remove all contigs present in POSITIVE controls

```{r}
Mastertable_no_mock <- Mastertable_decontam[!(Mastertable_decontam$PrevalencePosControls > 0),]
Mastertable_no_mock <- Mastertable_no_mock %>%
    filter(!Final_Genus %in% c("Alphainfluenzavirus"))
```

### Remove all non-viral contigs

```{r}
Mastertable_viral <- Mastertable_no_mock %>% 
    filter(grepl("viruses", Final_Classification)) %>%
    select(-all_of(c(neg_controls, pos_controls)))
```

### Add orthototiviridae genera from phylogenetic analysis

```{r}
tree_orthototi <- read.tree("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/ORTHOTOTIVIRIDAE/complete_orthototiviridae_with_outg.aln_trimmed.fasta.treefile")

orthototi_references <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/ORTHOTOTIVIRIDAE/ICTV_orthototiviridae_RdRps_with_outg.tsv", header = TRUE)

tree_orthototi_all_contigs_with_RdRps <- read.tree("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/ORTHOTOTIVIRIDAE/all_orthototiviridae_with_outg.aln.fasta.treefile")

my_complete_orthoti <- c("DermYa Orthototivirus 1" = "NODE_A5_length_4617_cov_1992.922907_201_NIL_1",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 1" = "NODE_A7_length_4035_cov_296.875442_202_NIL_2",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 1" = "NODE_A3_length_3754_cov_510.757139_208_NL_2",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 1" = "NODE_A2_length_4560_cov_988.028998_207_NIL_2",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 1" = "NODE_A4_length_4357_cov_849.579673_202_NIL_1",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 1" = "NODE_A2_length_4385_cov_213.898561_209_NIL_1",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 2" = "NODE_A7_length_4529_cov_1142.607143_201_NIL_2",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 2" = "NODE_A5_length_4306_cov_548.590683_202_NIL_2",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 2" = "NODE_B3_length_4150_cov_18.108765_204_IL_3",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 2" = "NODE_A4_length_4345_cov_666.457826_210_NIL_1",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 2" = "NODE_A20_length_2839_cov_217.490224_202_IL_2",
                         "DermYa Orthototivirus 3" = "NODE_A459_length_3790_cov_391.695933_205_NL_2")

my_complete_orthoti <- data.frame(
    Accession = my_complete_orthoti,
    Species = names(my_complete_orthoti),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

orthototi_references_new <- merge(orthototi_references, my_complete_orthoti, by = c("Accession", "Species"), all = TRUE)

additional_tips <- tree_orthototi_all_contigs_with_RdRps$tip.label[
    grepl("NODE", tree_orthototi_all_contigs_with_RdRps$tip.label) &
        !tree_orthototi_all_contigs_with_RdRps$tip.label %in% my_complete_orthoti$Accession]

dist_matrix <- cophenetic(tree_orthototi_all_contigs_with_RdRps)

closest_refs <- sapply(additional_tips, function(seq) {
    dists <- dist_matrix[seq, ]
    dists_ref <- dists[names(dists) %in% orthototi_references_new$Accession]
    names(which.min(dists_ref))})

assigned_clades <- orthototi_references_new %>%
    filter(Accession %in% closest_refs) %>%
    select(Accession, Species)

assigned_orthototi <- data.frame(CONTIGS = additional_tips, ClosestRef = closest_refs) %>%
    left_join(assigned_clades, by = c("ClosestRef" = "Accession")) %>%
    rename("Orthototi_phylo" = "Species")

assigned_orthototi <- merge(assigned_orthototi, my_complete_orthoti, by.x = c("CONTIGS", "Orthototi_phylo"), by.y = c("Accession", "Species"), all = TRUE)

assigned_orthototi$CONTIGS <- sub("_[0-9]+$", "", assigned_orthototi$CONTIGS)

Mastertable_viral$Final_Genus[Mastertable_viral$Final_Family == "Orthototiviridae"] <- "Totivirus"
Mastertable_viral$Final_Species[Mastertable_viral$Final_Family == "Orthototiviridae"] <- NA

Mastertable_viral <- Mastertable_viral %>%
    left_join(assigned_orthototi %>% select(CONTIGS, Orthototi_phylo), by = "CONTIGS")

Mastertable_viral <- Mastertable_viral %>%
    mutate(Final_Species = if_else(Final_Family == "Orthototiviridae", Orthototi_phylo,
                                   Final_Species)) %>%
    mutate(Final_Species = if_else(Final_Family == "Orthototiviridae" & is.na(Final_Species), "Unclassified Orthototiviridae",
                                   Final_Species)) %>%
    select(-Orthototi_phylo)
```

### Generate counts table

```{r}
Raw_reads <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/COUNTS/ADOVAC_PID.number_raw_reads.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = c("Samples", "Raw_reads"))

Trimmed_reads <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/COUNTS/ADOVAC_PID.number_trimmed_reads.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = c("Samples", "Trimmed_reads"))

Hostout_reads <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/MERGED_SAMPLES/COUNTS/ADOVAC_PID.number_hostout_reads.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = c("Samples", "Hostout_reads"))

Mapped_reads <- data.frame(Samples = colnames(abundance_table[,-1]), Mapped_reads = as.vector(colSums(abundance_table[,-1], na.rm = TRUE)))

Contigs <- data.frame(Samples = colnames(abundance_table[,-1]), Contigs = as.vector(colSums(abundance_table != 0, na.rm = TRUE)[-1]))

Mapped_viral_reads <- Mastertable_viral %>% 
    select(all_of(samples)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%  
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Samples", values_to = "Mapped_viral_reads")

Viral_contigs <- Mastertable_viral %>% 
    select(all_of(samples)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum( . > 0, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%  
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Samples", values_to = "Viral_contigs")

COUNTS <- merge(Raw_reads, Trimmed_reads, by = "Samples")
COUNTS$Percentage_trimmed <- (COUNTS$Trimmed_reads/COUNTS$Raw_reads)*100
COUNTS <- merge(COUNTS, Hostout_reads, by = "Samples")
COUNTS$Percentage_hostout <- (COUNTS$Hostout_reads/COUNTS$Raw_reads)*100
COUNTS <- merge(COUNTS, Mapped_reads, by = "Samples")
COUNTS$Percentage_mapped <- (COUNTS$Mapped_reads/COUNTS$Raw_reads)*100
COUNTS <- merge(COUNTS, Contigs, by = "Samples")
COUNTS <- merge(COUNTS, Mapped_viral_reads, by = "Samples", all = TRUE)
COUNTS$Percentage_mapped_viral <- (COUNTS$Mapped_viral_reads/COUNTS$Raw_reads)*100
COUNTS <- merge(COUNTS, Viral_contigs, by = "Samples", all = TRUE)
```

**REFERENCE-GUIDED ASSEMBLY APPROACH**

### Retrieve Esviritu abundance table

```{r}
esviritu_output <- read.delim("data/REFERENCE_GUIDED_ASSEMBLY/ESVIRITU/SUMMARY.detected_virus.info.tsv", header = TRUE)

esviritu_output <- esviritu_output %>%
    mutate(perc_covered = covered_bases / Length * 100)
```

### Define filtering threshold and clean abundance table

```{r}
nc_control_max <- esviritu_output %>%
    filter(grepl("NC", sample_ID)) %>%
    group_by(Accession) %>%
    summarise(
        nc_max_control_cov = max(perc_covered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pc_control_max <- esviritu_output %>%
    filter(grepl("iPC", sample_ID)) %>%
    group_by(Accession) %>%
    summarise(
        pc_max_control_cov = max(perc_covered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

esviritu_output_clean_with_pc <- esviritu_output %>%
    left_join(nc_control_max, by = "Accession") %>%
    filter(is.na(nc_max_control_cov) | perc_covered >= 3 * nc_max_control_cov) %>%
    select(-nc_max_control_cov)

esviritu_output_clean <- esviritu_output_clean_with_pc %>%
    left_join(pc_control_max, by = "Accession") %>%
    filter(is.na(pc_max_control_cov) | perc_covered >= 3 * pc_max_control_cov) %>%
    select(-pc_max_control_cov)

esviritu_output_filtered_clean <- esviritu_output_clean %>%
    filter(Length >= 10000 & perc_covered > 5 | Length < 10000 & covered_bases >= 500)
```

### Standardize detected taxa names

```{r}
esviritu_output_filtered_clean <- esviritu_output_filtered_clean %>%
    mutate(
        plot_taxa = case_when(
            grepl("Cutibacterium phage|Propionibacterium phage|Pahexavirus", species) ~ "Cutibacterium phages",
            grepl("Pseudomonas phage", species) ~ "Pseudomonas phages",
            grepl("Streptococcus phage|Brussowvirus 20617", species) ~ "Streptococcus phages",
            grepl("Staphylococcus phage|Andhravirus", species) ~ "Staphylococcus phages",
            grepl("Enterobacter phage", species) ~ "Enterobacter phages",
            grepl("Acinetobacter phage", species) ~ "Acinetobacter phages",
            grepl("Hafnia phage", species) ~ "Hafnia phages",
            grepl("Salmonella phage", species) ~ "Salmonella phages",
            grepl("Klebsiella phage", species) ~ "Klebsiella phages",
            grepl("Shigella phage", species) ~ "Shigella phages",
            grepl("Escherichia phage|Stx2c-converting phage", species) ~ "Escherichia phages",
            grepl("Alcaligenes phage", species) ~ "Alcaligenes phages",
            grepl("Lactococcus phage", species) ~ "Lactococcus phages",
            grepl("Gardnerella phage", species) ~ "Gardnerella phages",
            grepl("Lactobacillus phage", species) ~ "Lactobacillus phages",
            grepl("Paracoccus phage", species) ~ "Paracoccus phages",
            grepl("Pectobacterium phage", species) ~ "Pectobacterium phages",
            grepl("Bacteroides phage", species) ~ "Bacteroides phages",
            grepl("Betapapillomavirus", species) ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Betapapillomaviruses)",
            grepl("Gammapapillomavirus", species) ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Gammapapillomaviruses)",
            grepl("Mupapillomavirus", species) ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Mupapillomaviruses)",
            grepl("Human papillomavirus", species) ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Unclassified papillomaviruses)",
            TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
        )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        plot_taxa = case_when(
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Bacteriophage|phage|Phage", species) ~ "Unclassified phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Cutibacterium phage|Propionibacterium phage|Pahexavirus", subspecies) ~ "Cutibacterium phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Pseudomonas phage", subspecies) ~ "Pseudomonas phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Streptococcus phage|Brussowvirus 20617", subspecies) ~ "Streptococcus phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Staphylococcus phage|Andhravirus", subspecies) ~ "Staphylococcus phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Acinetobacter phage", subspecies) ~ "Acinetobacter phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Enterobacter phage", subspecies) ~ "Enterobacter phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Salmonella phage", subspecies) ~ "Salmonella phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Klebsiella phage", subspecies) ~ "Klebsiella phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Shigella phage", subspecies) ~ "Shigella phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Escherichia phage|Stx2c-converting phage", subspecies) ~ "Escherichia phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Alcaligenes phage", subspecies) ~ "Alcaligenes phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Lactococcus phage", subspecies) ~ "Lactococcus phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Gardnerella phage", subspecies) ~ "Gardnerella phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Lactobacillus phage", subspecies) ~ "Lactobacillus phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Paracoccus phage", subspecies) ~ "Paracoccus phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Pectobacterium phage", subspecies) ~ "Pectobacterium phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Bacteroides phage", subspecies) ~ "Bacteroides phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Actinomyces phage", subspecies) ~ "Actinomyces phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Xylella phage", subspecies) ~ "Xylella phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Corynebacterium phage", subspecies) ~ "Corynebacterium phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Hafnia phage", subspecies) ~ "Hafnia phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Bacteriophage|phage|Phages", subspecies) ~ "Unclassified phages",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Betapapillomavirus", subspecies) ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Betapapillomaviruses)",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Gammapapillomavirus", subspecies) ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Gammapapillomaviruses)",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Mupapillomavirus", subspecies) ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Mupapillomaviruses)",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" & grepl("Human papillomavirus", subspecies) ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Unclassified papillomaviruses)",
            plot_taxa == "Unclassified" ~ "Eukaryotic viruses\n(others)",
            TRUE ~ plot_taxa
        )
    )
```

## INDIVIDUAL SAMPLES

**DE NOVO ASSEMBLY APPROACH**

### Retrieve abundance table

```{r}
abundance_table_indiv <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/INDIVIDUAL_SAMPLES/ABUNDANCES/abundance_table.csv", sep=",", header=T, check.names = FALSE)

# Create 3 lists: all names, samples only, negative controls and positive controls
allnames_indiv <- metadata_indiv_samples %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

samples_indiv <- metadata_indiv_samples %>% 
    filter(!CONDITION == "Control") %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

acne_indiv <- metadata_indiv_samples %>% 
    filter(CONDITION == "Acne") %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

healthy_indiv <- metadata_indiv_samples %>% 
    filter(CONDITION == "Healthy") %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

neg_controls_indiv <- metadata_indiv_samples %>%
    filter(grepl("NC", SAMPLE_ID)) %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)

pos_controls_indiv <- metadata_indiv_samples %>%
    filter(grepl("PC", SAMPLE_ID)) %>%
    pull(SAMPLE_ID)
```

### Calculate prevalence and total abundances ---- 

```{r}
Prevalence_abundance_indiv <- abundance_table_indiv %>%
    mutate(
        PrevalenceSamples = rowSums(select(., all_of(samples_indiv)) != 0),
        PrevalenceNegControls = rowSums(select(., all_of(neg_controls_indiv)) != 0),
        PrevalencePosControls = rowSums(select(., all_of(pos_controls_indiv)) != 0),
        AbundanceSamples = rowSums(select(., all_of(samples_indiv))),
        AbundanceNegControls = rowSums(select(., all_of(neg_controls_indiv))),
        AbundancePosControls = rowSums(select(., all_of(pos_controls_indiv)))) %>%
    select(-all_of(allnames_indiv))
```

### Generate taxonomy table

#### Load Diamond output

```{r}
Taxonomy_Diamond_indiv <- read.csv("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/INDIVIDUAL_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/DIAMOND/ADOVAC.1000_contigs_95-85_diamond_taxonomy.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")
colnames(Taxonomy_Diamond_indiv) <- c('CONTIGS', 'Diamond_Classification', 'Diamond_Phylum', 'Diamond_Class', 'Diamond_Order', 'Diamond_Family', 'Diamond_Genus', 'Diamond_Species')
```

#### Load geNomad output

```{r}
Taxonomy_Genomad_indiv <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/INDIVIDUAL_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/GENOMAD/All_samples_clustered_95-85_virus_taxonomy.tsv", header = TRUE)
colnames(Taxonomy_Genomad_indiv) <- c('CONTIGS', 'Genomad_Classification', 'Genomad_Realm', 'Genomad_Kingdom', 'Genomad_Phylum', 'Genomad_Class', 'Genomad_Order', 'Genomad_Family', 'Genomad_Subfamily', 'Genomad_Genus', 'Genomad_Species')
Taxonomy_Genomad_indiv <- subset(Taxonomy_Genomad_indiv, select = -c(Genomad_Realm, Genomad_Kingdom, Genomad_Subfamily))
```

#### Merge outputs to build taxonomy table

```{r}
taxonomy_table_indiv <- abundance_table_indiv %>%
    select(CONTIGS) %>%
    left_join(Taxonomy_Diamond_indiv, by = "CONTIGS") %>%
    left_join(Taxonomy_Genomad_indiv, by = "CONTIGS")
```

#### Identify eukaryotic viruses and phages based on ICTV's host source

```{r}
for (tool in annotations_tools){
    classification <- paste0(tool, "_Classification")
    for (rank in ICTV_ranks){
        tool_rank <- paste0(tool, "_", rank)
        if (tool_rank %in% colnames(taxonomy_table_indiv)){
            taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] <- ifelse(is.na(taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification]) | taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] == "" | taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] == "Root", 
                                                      "Unknown", taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification])
            taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] == "Viruses" & taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank] %in% ICTV_phages_taxa_list,
                                                      "Prokaryotic viruses", taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification])
            taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] == "Viruses" & taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank] %in% ICTV_eukvir_taxa_list,
                                                      "Eukaryotic viruses", taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification])
        }
    }
    taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification] == "Viruses",
                                              "Unclassified viruses", taxonomy_table_indiv[,classification])
}

taxonomy_table_indiv$Genomad_Classification <- ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv$Genomad_Classification == "Unclassified", "Unclassified viruses", taxonomy_table_indiv$Genomad_Classification)

levels <- c("Classification", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")

for (tool in annotations_tools){
    for (i in 1:(length(levels)-1)){
        tool_rank <- paste0(tool, "_", levels[i+1])
        if (tool_rank %in% colnames(taxonomy_table_indiv)){
            tool_rank0 <- paste0(tool, "_", levels[i])
            taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank] == "" | is.na(taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank]),
                                                 gsub("Unclassified Unclassified", "Unclassified", paste("Unclassified", taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank0])),
                                                 taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank])
            taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank] == "Unclassified Unknown", "Unknown", taxonomy_table_indiv[,tool_rank])
        }
    }        
}

rm(i, classification, rank, tool, tool_rank, tool_rank0)
```

#### Insert final classification of contigs in taxonomy table

```{r}
taxonomy_table_indiv$Final_Tool <- "1"

taxonomy_table_indiv <- taxonomy_table_indiv %>%
    mutate(
        Final_Tool = case_when(
            Genomad_Classification == "Prokaryotic viruses" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Genomad",
            Diamond_Classification == "Eukaryotic viruses" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Genomad_Classification == "Unclassified viruses" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Genomad",
            Diamond_Classification %in% c("Unclassified viruses", "Prokaryotic viruses") &
                Genomad_Classification == "Eukaryotic viruses" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Tool clash",
            Diamond_Classification == "Bacteria" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Diamond_Classification == "Eukaryota" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Diamond_Classification == "Archaea" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Diamond_Classification == "Unknown" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Diamond",
            Genomad_Classification == "Unknown" & Final_Tool == "1" ~ "Genomad",
            TRUE ~ Final_Tool
        )
    )

for (i in 1:(length(levels))) {
    final_level <- paste0("Final", "_", levels[i])
    diamond_level <- paste0("Diamond", "_", levels[i])
    genomad_level <- paste0("Genomad", "_", levels[i])
    taxonomy_table_indiv[,final_level] <- ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv$Final_Tool == "Diamond", taxonomy_table_indiv[,diamond_level],
                                           ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv$Final_Tool == "Genomad", taxonomy_table_indiv[,genomad_level], 
                                                         ifelse(taxonomy_table_indiv$Final_Tool == "Tool clash", "Unclassified viruses", NA)))
}
```

### Identify contaminants with decontam

```{r}
### Format the abundance table for the phyloseq object
OTU <- abundance_table_indiv
OTU[is.na(OTU)] <- 0
row.names(OTU) <- OTU$CONTIGS
OTU$CONTIGS <- NULL
OTU <- as.matrix(OTU)

### Format the taxonomy table for the phyloseq object
TAX <- taxonomy_table_indiv
row.names(TAX) <- TAX$CONTIGS
TAX$CONTIGS <- NULL
TAX <- as.matrix(TAX)

OTU <- otu_table(OTU, taxa_are_rows=T)
TAX <- tax_table(TAX)
METADATA <- sample_data(transform(metadata_indiv_samples, row.names = SAMPLE_ID))

ADOVAC <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX, METADATA)

sample_data(ADOVAC)$is.neg <- sample_data(ADOVAC)$SAMPLE_ID %in% neg_controls_indiv
contamdf.prev <- isContaminant(ADOVAC, method="prevalence", neg="is.neg", threshold = 0.1)

contamdf.prev <- merge(contamdf.prev, Prevalence_abundance_indiv, by.x = 0, by.y = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
colnames(contamdf.prev)[1] <- "CONTIGS"
```

### Generate Mastertable

#### Load CheckV ouput

```{r}
CheckV_output_indiv <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/INDIVIDUAL_SAMPLES/PHAGE_ANNOTATION/CHECKV/quality_summary_R.tsv", header = TRUE)
colnames(CheckV_output_indiv) <- c('CONTIGS', 'provirus', 'proviral length', 'total_genes', 'viral_genes', 'checkv_quality', 'completeness')
```

#### Load geNomad ouput

```{r}
geNomad_output_indiv <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/INDIVIDUAL_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/GENOMAD/All_samples_clustered_95-85_virus_scores.tsv", header = TRUE)
colnames(geNomad_output_indiv) <- c('CONTIGS', 'length', 'topology', 'coordinates', 'n_genes', 'genetic_code', 'virus_score', 'fdr', 'n_hallmarks', 'marker_enrichment')
geNomad_output_indiv$CONTIGS <- gsub("\\|provirus_.*", "", geNomad_output_indiv$CONTIGS)
  
viromics_tools_table_indiv <- merge(CheckV_output_indiv, geNomad_output_indiv, by = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
```

#### Create a Mastertable merging abundance table, taxonomy table, and viromics tools 

```{r}
Mastertable_indiv <- merge(abundance_table_indiv, taxonomy_table_indiv[, grepl("CONTIGS|^Final_", colnames(taxonomy_table_indiv))], by = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
Mastertable_indiv <- merge(Mastertable_indiv, viromics_tools_table_indiv, by = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
Mastertable_indiv <- merge(Mastertable_indiv, contamdf.prev, by = "CONTIGS", all = TRUE)
```

#### Add genome length

```{r}
Mastertable_indiv$length[is.na(Mastertable_indiv$length)] <- gsub('.*_length_','',Mastertable_indiv$CONTIGS[is.na(Mastertable_indiv$length)])
Mastertable_indiv$length <- as.numeric(gsub("_cov_.*","", Mastertable_indiv$length))
```

### Remove all contigs considered as contaminants and present in NEGATIVE controls

```{r}
Mastertable_decontam_indiv <- Mastertable_indiv[Mastertable_indiv$contaminant == "FALSE",]
Mastertable_decontam_indiv <- Mastertable_indiv[!Mastertable_indiv$PrevalenceNegControls > 0,]
```

### Remove all contigs present in POSITIVE controls

```{r}
Mastertable_no_mock_indiv <- Mastertable_decontam_indiv[!(Mastertable_decontam_indiv$PrevalencePosControls > 0),]
Mastertable_no_mock_indiv <- Mastertable_no_mock_indiv %>%
    filter(!Final_Genus %in% c("Alphainfluenzavirus", "Betacoronavirus"))
```

### Remove all non-viral contigs

```{r}
Mastertable_viral_indiv <- Mastertable_no_mock_indiv %>% 
    filter(grepl("viruses", Final_Classification)) %>%
    select(-all_of(c(neg_controls_indiv, pos_controls_indiv)))
```

### Remove contigs that map to the human genome

```{r}
contigs_mapping_to_hg38 <- readLines("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/INDIVIDUAL_SAMPLES/VIRAL_CLASSIFICATION/BLASTN/ADOVAC.blastn_against_hg38.txt")
Mastertable_viral_indiv <- Mastertable_viral_indiv %>%
    filter(!(CONTIGS %in% contigs_mapping_to_hg38))
```

### Generate counts table

```{r}
Raw_reads_indiv <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/INDIVIDUAL_SAMPLES/COUNTS/ADOVAC.number_raw_reads.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = c("Samples", "Raw_reads"))

Trimmed_reads_indiv <- read.delim("data/DE_NOVO_ASSEMBLY/INDIVIDUAL_SAMPLES/COUNTS/ADOVAC.number_trimmed_reads.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = c("Samples", "Trimmed_reads"))

Mapped_reads_indiv <- data.frame(Samples = colnames(abundance_table_indiv[,-1]), Mapped_reads = as.vector(colSums(abundance_table_indiv[,-1], na.rm = TRUE)))

Contigs_indiv <- data.frame(Samples = colnames(abundance_table_indiv[,-1]), Contigs = as.vector(colSums(abundance_table_indiv != 0, na.rm = TRUE)[-1]))

Mapped_viral_reads_indiv <- Mastertable_viral_indiv %>% 
    select(all_of(samples_indiv)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%  
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Samples", values_to = "Mapped_viral_reads")

Viral_contigs_indiv <- Mastertable_viral_indiv %>% 
    select(all_of(samples_indiv)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum( . > 0, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%  
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Samples", values_to = "Viral_contigs")

COUNTS_indiv <- merge(Raw_reads_indiv, Trimmed_reads_indiv, by = "Samples")
COUNTS_indiv$Percentage_trimmed <- (COUNTS_indiv$Trimmed_reads/COUNTS_indiv$Raw_reads)*100
COUNTS_indiv <- merge(COUNTS_indiv, Mapped_reads_indiv, by = "Samples")
COUNTS_indiv$Percentage_mapped <- (COUNTS_indiv$Mapped_reads/COUNTS_indiv$Raw_reads)*100
COUNTS_indiv <- merge(COUNTS_indiv, Contigs_indiv, by = "Samples")
COUNTS_indiv <- merge(COUNTS_indiv, Mapped_viral_reads_indiv, by = "Samples", all = TRUE)
COUNTS_indiv$Percentage_mapped_viral <- (COUNTS_indiv$Mapped_viral_reads/COUNTS_indiv$Raw_reads)*100
COUNTS_indiv <- merge(COUNTS_indiv, Viral_contigs_indiv, by = "Samples", all = TRUE)
```

Summary count statistics on all samples:
```{r}
# Min, max and median for all samples
summary(COUNTS_indiv[c("Samples","Raw_reads", "Trimmed_reads", "Mapped_reads", "Mapped_viral_reads")] %>% filter(Samples %in% samples_indiv))

# Min, max and median for acne samples
summary(COUNTS_indiv[c("Samples","Raw_reads", "Trimmed_reads", "Mapped_reads", "Mapped_viral_reads")] %>% filter(Samples %in% acne_indiv))

# Min, max and median for healthy samples
summary(COUNTS_indiv[c("Samples","Raw_reads", "Trimmed_reads", "Mapped_reads", "Mapped_viral_reads")] %>% filter(Samples %in% healthy_indiv))

# Min, max and median for positive controls
summary(COUNTS_indiv[c("Samples","Raw_reads", "Trimmed_reads", "Mapped_reads", "Mapped_viral_reads")] %>% filter(Samples == "iPC"))

# Min, max and median for collection negative controls
summary(COUNTS_indiv[c("Samples","Raw_reads", "Trimmed_reads", "Mapped_reads", "Mapped_viral_reads")] %>% filter(Samples == "NC"))

# Min, max and median for extraction negative controls
summary(COUNTS_indiv[c("Samples","Raw_reads", "Trimmed_reads", "Mapped_reads", "Mapped_viral_reads")] %>% filter(Samples == "iNC"))

# Min, max and median for amplification negative controls
summary(COUNTS_indiv[c("Samples","Raw_reads", "Trimmed_reads", "Mapped_reads", "Mapped_viral_reads")] %>% filter(Samples == "aNC"))
```

## Figure 1

### Figure 1a
```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4, fig.align = 'center'}
data_plot <- COUNTS %>% 
    filter(Samples %in% c(samples)) %>%
    select(Raw_reads, Trimmed_reads, Hostout_reads, Mapped_reads, Mapped_viral_reads) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%  
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
                 names_to = "Subgroup",
                 values_to = "Total") %>%
    mutate(Percentage = Total / Total[Subgroup == "Raw_reads"] * 100)

data_plot <- data_plot %>% 
    mutate(Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = c("Raw_reads", "Trimmed_reads", "Hostout_reads", "Mapped_reads", "Mapped_viral_reads"),
                             labels = c("Raw","Deduplicated\n+ Trimmed", "After host\nremoval",
                                        "Mapping to de novo\nassembled contigs",
                                        "Mapping to viral OTUs"))) 

ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = Subgroup, y = Percentage, fill = Subgroup)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values =  c(wes_palette("Moonrise2"), wes_palette("Moonrise1"))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme (
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_markdown(),
        legend.position = " none") +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, digits = 1), "%\nN = ", scientific(Total))), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.24)))
```

### Figure 1b
```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4, fig.align = 'center'}
data_plot <- Mastertable_viral %>%
    select(CONTIGS, Final_Classification, length) %>%
    mutate(Final_Classification = factor(Final_Classification, levels = c("Unclassified viruses", "Eukaryotic viruses", "Prokaryotic viruses")))

ggplot(data_plot, aes(length, fill = Final_Classification, color = Final_Classification)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, position = "stack", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(wes_palette("Cavalcanti1")[c(5, 1, 2)], 0.5)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("white", "white", "white")) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000),
                  labels = c("1kb", "5kb", "10kb", "50kb", "100kb")) +
    labs(y = "Number of vOTUs", x = "Length of vOTUs (Log10)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE), color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))+
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))
```

## Figure 2

### Figure 2a
```{r, fig.width = 18, fig.height = 4, fig.align = 'center'}

samples_with_reads <- Mastertable_viral %>%
    select(all_of(samples)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    select_if(~ . > 0) %>%
    colnames()

abundances_TPM_pos_only <- Mastertable_viral %>%
    select(all_of(c("CONTIGS", "length", samples_with_reads)), all_of(grep("^Final", colnames(Mastertable_viral)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = samples_with_reads, names_to = "SAMPLE_ID", values_to = "mapped_reads") 

abundances_TPM_pos_only$RPK <- abundances_TPM_pos_only$mapped_reads/abundances_TPM_pos_only$length

data_plot <- abundances_TPM_pos_only %>%
    group_by(SAMPLE_ID, Final_Family) %>%
    summarize(RPK = sum(RPK), .groups = "drop_last")

data_plot <- data_plot %>%
    group_by(SAMPLE_ID) %>%
    mutate(RPK_total = sum(RPK),
           TPM = (RPK / RPK_total) * 10^6)

data_plot <- merge(data_plot, metadata, by = "SAMPLE_ID", all = FALSE)

data_summary <- data_plot %>%
    mutate(LESION_INFL = factor(LESION_INFL, levels = c("Healthy", "No_lesions", "Non-inflammatory_lesions", "Inflammatory_lesions"),
            labels = c("Healthy Control Group", "No lesions", "Non-inflammatory lesions", "Inflammatory lesions")))

data_summary <- data_summary %>%
    mutate(Final_Family = factor(Final_Family, levels = rev(names(MyColorsViralFamilies))))

ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = TPM, y = PID, fill = Final_Family)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
    labs(x = "Relative Abundance of Viral Families in Transcripts Per Kilobase Million (TPM)", y = "", fill = "Viral Family")  +
    scale_fill_manual(values=MyColorsViralFamilies, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.direction = "vertical",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm")) +
    guides(fill=guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, nrow = 15)) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
    facet_wrap(~ LESION_INFL, scales = "free", nrow = 1)
```

### Figure 2b
```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3, fig.align = 'center'}
samples_with_reads <- Mastertable_viral_indiv %>%
    select(all_of(samples_indiv)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    select_if(~ . > 0) %>%
    colnames()

abundances_TPM_pos_only <- Mastertable_viral_indiv %>%
    select(all_of(c("CONTIGS", "length", samples_with_reads)), all_of(grep("^Final", colnames(Mastertable_viral_indiv)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = samples_with_reads, names_to = "SAMPLE_ID", values_to = "mapped_reads") 

abundances_TPM_pos_only$RPK <- abundances_TPM_pos_only$mapped_reads/abundances_TPM_pos_only$length

data_plot <- abundances_TPM_pos_only %>%
    group_by(SAMPLE_ID, Final_Family) %>%
    summarize(RPK = sum(RPK), .groups = "drop_last")

data_plot <- data_plot %>%
    group_by(SAMPLE_ID) %>%
    mutate(RPK_total = sum(RPK),
           TPM = (RPK / RPK_total) * 10^6)

data_plot <- merge(data_plot, metadata_indiv_samples, by = "SAMPLE_ID", all = FALSE)

data_summary <- data_plot %>%
    group_by(PID, SAMPLE_TYPE, Final_Family) %>%
    summarize(mean_TPM_patient = mean(TPM), 
              n_per_PID = n(), .groups = "drop")

data_summary <- data_summary %>%
    mutate(SAMPLE_TYPE = factor(SAMPLE_TYPE, levels = c("Skin gel strip", "Skin swab"),
                              labels = c("Skin gel strips", "Skin swabs")))

counts <- data_summary %>% 
    group_by(SAMPLE_TYPE) %>% 
    summarise(N = n_distinct(PID))

x_labels <- setNames(paste0(levels(data_summary$SAMPLE_TYPE), "\nN = ", counts$N), levels(data_summary$SAMPLE_TYPE))

stat.test <- data_summary %>% 
    group_by(Final_Family) %>%
    wilcox_test(mean_TPM_patient ~ SAMPLE_TYPE, paired = TRUE) %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    mutate(y.position = 1050000)

data_summary <- data_summary %>%
    mutate(Final_Family = factor(Final_Family, levels = names(MyColorsViralFamilies)))

stat.test$Final_Family <- factor(stat.test$Final_Family, levels = levels(data_summary$Final_Family))

data_summary <- data_summary %>%
    filter(Final_Family %in% stat.test$Final_Family[!stat.test$p.signif == "ns"])

ggplot(data_summary, (aes(x=SAMPLE_TYPE, y = mean_TPM_patient))) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(color = Final_Family, fill = Final_Family), width = 0.5, alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Final_Family), width = 0.1, height = 0, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = MyColorsViralFamilies) +
    scale_color_manual(values = MyColorsViralFamilies) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Relative Abundance of Viral Families \nin Transcripts Per Kilobase Million (TPM)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          strip.text = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10, t = 10))) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
    facet_wrap(~Final_Family, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "top", nrow = 1) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.signif", hide.ns = TRUE, tip.length = 0) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1000000), clip = "off")
```

### Figure 4b
```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4, fig.align = 'center'}
abundances_TPM <- Mastertable_viral %>%
    filter(Final_Family == "Orthototiviridae") %>%
    select(c("CONTIGS", "length"), all_of(samples), all_of(grep("^Final", colnames(Mastertable_viral)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = samples, names_to = "SAMPLE_ID", values_to = "mapped_reads") 

abundances_TPM$RPK <- abundances_TPM$mapped_reads/abundances_TPM$length

abundances_TPM <- abundances_TPM %>%
    filter(Final_Family == "Orthototiviridae") %>%
    group_by(SAMPLE_ID, Final_Species) %>%
    summarize(RPK = sum(RPK), .groups = 'drop')

abundances_TPM <- abundances_TPM %>%
    group_by(SAMPLE_ID) %>%
    mutate(RPK_total = sum(RPK),
           TPM = (RPK / RPK_total) * 10^6)

abundances_TPM$TPM[is.nan(abundances_TPM$TPM)] <- 0

data_plot <- merge(abundances_TPM, metadata, by = "SAMPLE_ID", all = FALSE)

data_summary <- data_plot %>%
    group_by(PID, LESION_INFL) %>%
    summarize(observed_richness = sum(TPM > 0), 
              shannon_diversity = diversity(c_across(TPM), index = "shannon"),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    ungroup()

data_summary <- data_summary %>%
    mutate(LESION_INFL = factor(LESION_INFL, levels = c("Healthy", "No_lesions", "Non-inflammatory_lesions", "Inflammatory_lesions"),
                                labels = c("Healthy\nControl Group", "No lesions", "Non-inflammatory\nlesions", "Inflammatory\nlesions")))

counts <- data_summary %>%
    group_by(LESION_INFL) %>%
    summarise(N = n_distinct(PID))

x_labels <- setNames(paste0(levels(data_summary$LESION_INFL), "\nN = ", counts$N), levels(data_summary$LESION_INFL))

model <- glmmTMB(
    observed_richness ~ LESION_INFL + (1|PID),
    family = compois,
    data = data_summary)

sim <- simulateResiduals(model)
testUniformity(sim, plot = FALSE)
testDispersion(sim, plot = FALSE)
testZeroInflation(sim, plot = FALSE)

estimated_marginal_means <- emmeans(model, ~ LESION_INFL)

pw_comparisons <- pairs(estimated_marginal_means, adjust = "BH")

pw_cmp_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pw_comparisons))
pw_cmp_df$contrast <- gsub("[()]", "", pw_cmp_df$contrast)

stat.test <- pw_cmp_df %>%
    mutate(
        group1 = sub(" - .*", "", contrast),
        group2 = sub(".* - ", "", contrast),
        y.position = max(data_summary$observed_richness, na.rm = TRUE) + seq(0.5, 3, by = 0.5)) %>%
    add_significance(p.col = "p.value", output.col = "p.adj.signif")

ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = LESION_INFL, y = observed_richness)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(color = LESION_INFL, fill = LESION_INFL), width = 0.5, alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = LESION_INFL), width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = MyColorsLesionsInfl) +
    scale_color_manual(values = MyColorsLesionsInfl) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    labs(x = "", y = expression(atop("Observed Richness",
                                     "of" ~ italic("Orthototiviridae") ~ "Species"))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(element_text(size = 10),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 1.2),
          axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 2, margin = margin(r = 15)),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "cm")) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.adj.signif", hide.ns = TRUE, tip.length = 0)
```

```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4, fig.align = 'center'}
model <- lmer(
    shannon_diversity ~ LESION_INFL + (1|PID),
    data = data_summary)

sim <- simulateResiduals(model)
testUniformity(sim, plot = FALSE)
testDispersion(sim, plot = FALSE)
testZeroInflation(sim, plot = FALSE)

estimated_marginal_means <- emmeans(model, ~ LESION_INFL)

pw_comparisons <- pairs(estimated_marginal_means, adjust = "BH")

pw_cmp_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pw_comparisons))
pw_cmp_df$contrast <- gsub("[()]", "", pw_cmp_df$contrast)

stat.test <- pw_cmp_df %>%
    mutate(
        group1 = sub(" - .*", "", contrast),
        group2 = sub(".* - ", "", contrast),
        y.position = max(data_summary$shannon_diversity, na.rm = TRUE) + seq(0.0, 1.0, by = 0.2)) %>%
    add_significance(p.col = "p.value", output.col = "p.adj.signif")

ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = LESION_INFL, y = shannon_diversity)) +

        cols_to_remove <- names(na_percent[na_percent > 10])

        unique_counts <- sapply(., function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x))))

        .

           "Skin phototype" = INC_PHOTOTYPE)

#Functions are copied from https://github.com/raeslab/RLdbRDA/tree/main
get_r2_single <- function(distmat, meta, feature) {
    capsc <- capscale(distmat ~ meta[, feature])
    an <- anova.cca(capsc)
    
    Fa <- an["F"][[1]][[1]]
    r2 <- RsquareAdj(capsc)[[1]]
    r2adj <- RsquareAdj(capsc)[[2]]
    N <- nrow(na.exclude(meta[,feature,drop=FALSE]))
    pval <- an["Pr(>F)"][[1]][[1]]
    
    output <- cbind(feature, Fa, r2, r2adj, N, pval)
    
    return(output)
}

get_r2 <- function(distmat, meta) {
    features = colnames(meta)
    
    all <- c()
    
    for (feature in features){
        es <- get_r2_single(distmat, meta, feature)
        all <- rbind(all, es)
    }
    
    all <- data.frame(all)
    all$padj <- p.adjust(all$pval, method="holm")
    
    rownames(all) <- all$feature
    
    return(all)
}

get_cumul <- function(distmat, meta) {
    mod0=capscale(distmat ~ 1) #H0: unconstrained ordination
    mod1=capscale(distmat ~ ., data=meta) #H1: full constrained ordination, all metadata
    
    
    attach(meta)
    
    set.seed(123)
    step.res<-ordiR2step(mod0, scope=formula(mod1), data=meta, direction="forward", Pin = 1, R2scope = TRUE, pstep = 100, perm.max = 999, permutations=9999, trace = F) #forward stepwise dbRDA
    res=step.res$anova
    
    
    row.names(res)=gsub(pattern="\\+ ", "",row.names(res))
    rownames(res) <- gsub(pattern = "`", "", rownames(res))
    colnames(res)=gsub(pattern="Pr\\(>F\\)", "pval", colnames(res)) # replace column name
    colnames(res)=paste0("RDAcumul_",colnames(res))
    res[,"RDAcumul_N"]=nrow(meta)
    
    detach(meta)
    
    
    return(res)
}

combine_data <- function(r2, cumul){
    
    all=data.frame(merge(r2,cumul,by="row.names",all=T),row.names=1)
    all=all[order(all$r2,decreasing=TRUE),]
    all=all[order(all$RDAcumul_R2.adj),]
    
    return(all)
}

prepare_plot_data <- function(dbrda_data) {
    # Define the order of the y-axis
    plot_order = rev(row.names(dbrda_data))
    
    # Impute missing values in RDAcumul_R2.adj with the largest non-NA value
    insignificant_features <- row.names(dbrda_data)[is.na(dbrda_data$RDAcumul_R2.adj)]
    max_val <- max(dbrda_data$RDAcumul_R2.adj, na.rm = TRUE)
    dbrda_data$RDAcumul_R2.adj[is.na(dbrda_data$RDAcumul_R2.adj)] <- max_val
    
    # Filter the data and reshape it to long form
    plot_data = dbrda_data %>%
        filter(row.names(dbrda_data) != "<All variables>") %>%
        select(r2adj, RDAcumul_R2.adj) %>%
        mutate(r2adj = as.numeric(r2adj)) %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "rowname") %>%
        pivot_longer(-rowname, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
        mutate(significant = ifelse(rowname %in% insignificant_features, 0, 1))
    
    plot_data$rowname <- factor(plot_data$rowname, levels = plot_order)
    
    return(plot_data)
}

bray_mat <- as.matrix(bray_dist)
bray_mat_clean <- bray_mat[rownames(clinical_covariate), rownames(clinical_covariate)]
bray_dist_clean <- as.dist(bray_mat_clean)

r2 <- get_r2(bray_dist_clean, clinical_covariate)

sign_r2 <- rownames(r2[which(r2$padj < 0.05),])

cumul <- get_cumul(bray_dist_clean, clinical_covariate[, sign_r2, drop=F])

out <- combine_data(r2, cumul)

plot_data <- prepare_plot_data(out)

ggplot(data = plot_data, aes(x = value, y = rowname, fill = variable)) +
    geom_bar(aes(alpha = significant), stat = 'identity', position = position_dodge2()) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    xlab('Effect size') +
    ylab(NULL) +
    labs(fill = "") + 
    guides(alpha="none") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("#D8B70A", "#02401B"),
                      labels=c(bquote(R^2), bquote('Cumulative' ~ R^2))) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3),
        labels = c("0", "0.1", "0.2", "0.3")) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.5, 1), limits = c(0, 1))

            LESION_INFL == "Healthy" ~ 1,
            LESION_INFL == "No_lesions" ~ 2,
            LESION_INFL == "Non-inflammatory_lesions" ~ 3,
            LESION_INFL == "Inflammatory_lesions" ~ 4,
            LESION_INFL == "Control" ~ 5,
            TRUE ~ 6
        ),
        
        # Create x-axis labels
        PID_label = case_when(
            LESION_INFL == "Healthy" ~ as.character(PID),
            LESION_INFL == "No_lesions" ~ paste0(PID, "_NL"),
            LESION_INFL == "Non-inflammatory_lesions" ~ paste0(PID, "_NIL"),
            LESION_INFL == "Inflammatory_lesions" ~ paste0(PID, "_IL"),
            LESION_INFL == "Control" ~ as.character(sample_ID),
            TRUE ~ as.character(PID)
        )
    ) %>%
    arrange(Lesion_order, Control_order, sample_ID)

data_plot$sample_ID <- factor(data_plot$sample_ID, levels = unique(data_plot$sample_ID))

heatmapCols <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "GnBu"))(20)

ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = sample_ID, y = factor(species, levels = rev(levels(factor(species)))), fill = TPM)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(data_plot$PID_label, data_plot$sample_ID)) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = heatmapCols, na.value="#F7FBFF", trans = 'log10') +
    labs(x = "Subject/Patient ID (by lesion type)", y = "Viral Species", fill = "Transcripts Per Kilobase Million (TPM)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
          axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 20)),
          legend.position = "bottom", 
          legend.justification = "left",
          legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
          text = element_text(size=10))
```

## Figure S5
```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4, fig.align = 'center'}

data_plot <- esviritu_output_filtered_clean %>%
    select(sample_ID, perc_covered)

data_summary <- merge(data_plot, metadata, by.x = "sample_ID", by.y = "SAMPLE_ID")

data_summary <- data_summary %>%
    mutate(LESION_INFL = factor(LESION_INFL, levels = c("Healthy", "No_lesions", "Non-inflammatory_lesions", "Inflammatory_lesions"),
                                labels = c("Healthy\nControl Group", "No lesions", "Non-inflammatory\nlesions", "Inflammatory\nlesions")))

counts <- data_summary %>%
    group_by(LESION_INFL) %>%
    summarise(N = n())

x_labels <- setNames(paste0(levels(data_summary$LESION_INFL), "\nN = ", counts$N), levels(data_summary$LESION_INFL))

model <- lmer(
    perc_covered ~ LESION_INFL + (1|PID),
    data = data_summary)

sim <- simulateResiduals(model)
testUniformity(sim, plot = FALSE)
testDispersion(sim, plot = FALSE)
testZeroInflation(sim, plot = FALSE)

estimated_marginal_means <- emmeans(model, ~ LESION_INFL)

pw_comparisons <- pairs(estimated_marginal_means, adjust = "BH")

pw_cmp_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pw_comparisons))
pw_cmp_df$contrast <- gsub("[()]", "", pw_cmp_df$contrast)

stat.test <- pw_cmp_df %>%
    mutate(
        group1 = sub(" - .*", "", contrast),
        group2 = sub(".* - ", "", contrast),
        y.position = max(data_summary$perc_covered, na.rm = TRUE) + seq(0.5, 3, by = 0.5)) %>%
    add_significance(p.col = "p.value", output.col = "p.adj.signif")

ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = LESION_INFL, y = perc_covered)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(color = LESION_INFL, fill = LESION_INFL), width = 0.5, alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = LESION_INFL), width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = MyColorsLesionsInfl) +
    scale_color_manual(values = MyColorsLesionsInfl) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    ylim(0, max(data_summary$perc_covered)) +
    labs(x = "", y = "% coverage of reference genomes") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(element_text(size = 10),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 1.2),
          axis.title.y = element_text(vjust = 2, margin = margin(r = 15)),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "cm")) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.adj.signif", hide.ns = TRUE, tip.length = 0)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
datatable(stat.test)
```

## Figure S6
```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 10, fig.align = 'center'}
abundances_TPM <- esviritu_output_filtered_clean %>%
    group_by(sample_ID, Length, Accession, plot_taxa) %>%
    summarize(tot_read_count = sum(read_count),
              .groups = 'drop')

abundances_TPM <- abundances_TPM %>%
    complete(sample_ID, nesting(plot_taxa, Length, Accession),
             fill = list(tot_read_count = 0)) %>%
    arrange(sample_ID, plot_taxa, Length) %>%
    mutate(RPK = tot_read_count / Length)

abundances_TPM <- abundances_TPM %>%
    group_by(sample_ID, plot_taxa) %>%
    summarize(RPK = sum(RPK), .groups = 'drop')

abundances_TPM <- abundances_TPM %>%
    group_by(sample_ID) %>%
    mutate(RPK_total = sum(RPK),
           TPM = (RPK / RPK_total) * 10^6)

data_plot <- merge(abundances_TPM, metadata, by.x = "sample_ID", by.y = "SAMPLE_ID")

data_plot <- data_plot %>%
    group_by(PID, CONDITION, plot_taxa) %>%
    summarize(mean_TPM_patient = mean(TPM),
              n_per_PID = n(), .groups = "drop")

data_plot <- data_plot %>%
    mutate(CONDITION = factor(CONDITION, levels = c("Healthy", "Acne"),
                              labels = c("Healthy", "Acne")))

data_plot <- data_plot %>%
    mutate(plot_taxa = factor(plot_taxa, 
                              levels = c(setdiff(sort(unique(plot_taxa)), c("Unclassified phages", "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Betapapillomaviruses)","Eukaryotic viruses\n(Gammapapillomaviruses)", "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Mupapillomaviruses)", "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Unclassified papillomaviruses)","Eukaryotic viruses\n(others)")), 
                                         "Unclassified phages", "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Betapapillomaviruses)","Eukaryotic viruses\n(Gammapapillomaviruses)", "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Mupapillomaviruses)", "Eukaryotic viruses\n(Unclassified papillomaviruses)","Eukaryotic viruses\n(others)")))

counts <- data_plot %>% 
    group_by(CONDITION) %>% 
    summarise(N = n_distinct(PID))

x_labels <- setNames(paste0(levels(data_plot$CONDITION), "\nN = ", counts$N), levels(data_plot$CONDITION))

stat.test <- data_plot %>% 
    group_by(plot_taxa) %>%
    wilcox_test(mean_TPM_patient ~ CONDITION, paired = FALSE) %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    add_y_position()

ggplot(data_plot, (aes(x=CONDITION, y = mean_TPM_patient))) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(color = plot_taxa, fill = plot_taxa), width = 0.5, alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = plot_taxa), width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = MyColorsEsviritu) +
    scale_color_manual(values = MyColorsEsviritu) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Relative Abundance of Detected Taxa (TPM)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          strip.text = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10, t = 10))) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
    facet_wrap(~plot_taxa, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "top", nrow=7) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.signif", hide.ns = TRUE, tip.length = 0) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1000000), clip = "off")
```
